title: Ravnica Allegiance Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.
"I await your donation." —Dasha, Orzhov priest
"I am my life's work."
Those who cross the Dimir find enemies everywhere they turn.
"To control the present we must master the future."
"I do not understand the future I see: the guilds subverted, the world at war, armies bent to a cruel conqueror's will."
In preparation for the conflict all foresaw, the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city.
"No worthwhile reward is easily gained." —Nicol Bolas
"Down here, things don't stay dead." —Lavinia
The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.
"Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."
"Hello, kindling."
"Places, everyone!" —Judith
"Smash this city to pieces." —Domri Rade
Simic's strength comes from its diversity.
"Rage! Rage until the whole world burns!"
"In your misguided attempt to subvert the law, you have eloquently explained why the law must exist."
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger." —Tajic
"Time to let the dead be dead." —Kaya, to Teysa
Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.
She displays her scars with pride.
Havoc is a small price to pay for data.
At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.
Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.
"I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."
"Your debt is erased." —Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist
"The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak—and their city—to dust!"
"Entertain me."
While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.
Life is a show, and death its final performance.
"One beginning, many paths." —Vannifar
Sin is debt, and absolution is paid in tithes of gold and blood.
The ever-watchful center of a growing web of eyes.
"What we begin, the End-Raze will finish. Then we will dance in Ravnica's rubble." —Nikya of the Old Ways
